data.title: 伊雷娜 · 屋顶花园
data.description: 【伊蕾娜 · 屋顶花园】晴朗的早晨，旅馆屋顶的花园开满鲜花，微风带着花香掠过城市天际线。伊蕾娜穿着柔和色调的便服，坐在扫帚上休息，回望你时露出轻轻扬起的自信笑意——「这样的好天气，当然也要留一点时间欣赏风景呀。」
data.action: 坐在扫帚上小憩，回望屋顶花园与城市风景
data.promptProse: Elaina pauses on her hovering broomstick in the rooftop flower garden, turning a gently self-satisfied smile toward the viewer. Her soft-colored everyday dress rests neatly over the seated pose. The medium view places blooms along the terrace edge and a city panorama beyond its parapet, with the broom visibly supporting her. Bright morning sun illuminates her silver hair and nearby petals, casting flower shadows across rooftop paving beneath the broom.
